_comment: MarketInk Quality Gate rule catalog for the function-level AI review. The reviewer may ONLY report findings under these rule ids. Projects enable/disable rules or add custom ones in .quality-gate.json -> review.rules. Bump 'version' whenever a rule's meaning changes (it is part of the review cache key in later phases).

rules.title: Nullable value dereferenced without a check
rules.check: A value that the packet shows can be null/undefined (a callee signature returning `T | null`/`T | undefined`, an optional property, Array.find, Map.get, a `{ data, error }` result) is dereferenced or passed on without a guard.

rules.title: Caller does not handle a null the changed function can now return
rules.check: The changed function can return or resolve null/undefined (or a new empty/partial shape) on some path, and a caller snippet in the packet uses the result without handling that case.

rules.title: Error swallowed
rules.check: A catch/rejection handler ignores the error or only logs it, and execution continues as if the operation succeeded, so callers or users see success for a failure.

rules.title: Returned error ignored
rules.check: A call that reports failure by return value (e.g. `{ data, error }`, `{ ok: false }`, a Result type, a non-2xx response) has its error ignored and its data used anyway.

rules.title: Throw/return contract mismatch
rules.check: The changed function now throws where callers in the packet expect a returned error, or returns an error value where callers expect a throw (their try/catch or result check no longer matches).

rules.title: Missing await
rules.check: A promise whose result or failure matters (its value is used, ordering matters, or a failure must stop the flow) is not awaited or returned.

rules.title: Floating promise / unhandled rejection
rules.check: A promise is started without await, return, .catch or an explicit fire-and-forget marker, in a path where a rejection would be unhandled or lost.

rules.title: Stale state across an await
rules.check: State read before an await is used after it without re-checking, so a concurrent change (another request, a re-render, a user switching context) can make the write or UI update apply to the wrong target.

rules.title: Call does not match the (changed) signature
rules.check: A call site in the packet passes arguments in the wrong order/count/meaning, or uses a return shape the changed function no longer provides.

rules.title: Changed behaviour breaks a caller's visible assumption
rules.check: The changed function's new behaviour (units, ordering, side effects, error cases, default values) contradicts an assumption that a caller snippet in the packet visibly relies on.

rules.title: Branch logic error
rules.check: A condition is inverted or incomplete, a branch is unreachable, or a state that can occur (shown in the packet) has no branch.

rules.title: Early exit skips required work
rules.check: A return/throw/continue path skips cleanup, a status update or a required write that the other paths perform (e.g. a record left 'pending'/'sending' forever).

rules.title: Operation can run twice
rules.check: A retry, re-entry, redelivery or double submit can repeat a side effect that must happen once (send, charge, insert) because no idempotency guard is visible in the packet.

rules.title: Off-by-one / boundary error
rules.check: Loop bounds, slices, pagination cursors, length checks or comparisons are off by one or mishandle the empty/first/last case.

rules.title: Sequential I/O in a loop
rules.check: An await (query, request, file op) runs inside a loop over a collection that can be large, where a batched or parallel form is available.

rules.title: Repeated expensive work
rules.check: The same query, computation or allocation runs per item / per render when it could be done once (hoisted, memoized, cached).

rules.title: Duplicated logic
rules.check: The changed code re-implements logic that an existing function visible in the packet already provides.

rules.title: Function does too much
rules.check: The changed function mixes unrelated responsibilities in a way that makes a specific bug likely (name the bug). Off by default: easy to turn into opinion.

rules.title: Dead code introduced
rules.check: The change adds unreachable code, an unused result of a side-effect-free call, or a branch whose condition is always true/false given the packet.

rules.title: Untrusted input reaches a sink unvalidated
rules.check: Input from a request, webhook, URL or user reaches a query, HTML, shell command, file path or redirect without validation/escaping visible in the packet.

rules.title: Missing authorization check
rules.check: A changed handler reads or writes a record by id without the ownership/role check that sibling code in the packet performs.

rules.title: Sensitive data exposed
rules.check: Tokens, secrets, credentials or personal data are written to logs, error messages, analytics or API responses.
